label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verse: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
note: David's prayer after Nathan confronted him — he asks for the joy back, not just the forgiveness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Till he fill thy mouth with _____, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verse: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
note: Bildad got this one right: God will yet fill thy mouth with laughing — and by the last chapter, Job is restored double.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And thus shall ye eat it; with your _____ girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
verse: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
note: The first Passover was eaten dressed for travel: loins girded, shoes on, staff in hand — dinner with the bags packed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that _____ on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verse: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
note: Ahab's one great line: don't brag while strapping armor on — boast when you take it off.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Casting down _____, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verse: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
note: Spiritual warfare, Pauline style: casting down 'imaginations' and taking every thought captive.
